Results.ReviewText: I bought my spirit Grill a little over 5 years ago when the kids moved out of the house and we bought our new home and I use it quite frequently and it's still looks brand new. Aside from having to replace a few minor parts like the burner tubes and flavor bars,  which do eventually rust out, this grill has been remarkably durable and it is the perfect size for my wife and I now that we're empty nesters.   I also got me one of Weber's new griddles to supplement my outdoor conjuring needs, which is a perfect set up for me!   I might also add that since I've had this grill, I've been more than willing to grill up much more expensive steaks because I know I won't kill it because of the evenness and dependability of cooking steaks.  I used to never dare to make expensive steaks on my old, cheaper grills because, more times than not, they just wouldn't come out right or they'd get burnt. Not any more!
Results.Title: Long term durability and good looks 👌🏿

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.

Welcome to the Weber family.
